item.title: Nikon dévoile un zoom lumineux unique au monde, mais à un prix affolant
item.description: Nikon commercialisera le 12 novembre 2026 le Nikkor Z 120-300mm f/2.8 TC VR S, un zoom à ouverture f/2,8 constante doté d'un téléconvertisseur 1,4x intégré qui le fait grimper à 420 mm. Son développement avait été annoncé le 7 mai.

item.title: FADU wants to take the CPU out of AI storage by putting the file system inside the SSD, but the proof won't arrive until 2027
item.description: FADU's new SSD runs its own file system, so GPUs and DPUs can read files without CPU intervention, but samples won't land until Q3 2027.

item.title: Moon phase today: What the Moon will look like on October 29, 2026
item.description: See the Moon phase expected for October 29, 2026 as well as when the next Full Moon is expected.

item.title: Bluesky Is Blocking Links to a Major Leak of DHS Employee Records
item.description: Bluesky tells WIRED it blocked links to a leaked archive of information on 41,000 ICE, CBP, and other DHS workers because it contains people’s contact information, shared without their authorization.

item.title: Starlink users heavily surveilled by alleged Israeli spy firm — company served ads to geolocate users and spy on browsers and apps
item.description: Malicious ads were deliberately served to Starlink users to uncover their identity and launch further surveillance efforts.

item.title: Claudes new smart reports tell bosses when workers are off-topic
item.description: Anthropic has announced new Claude reporting tools, allowing employers to see exactly how their employees are using the AI tool.
